intro: Volga is your personal reset button. With power recline, rocking motion, and a cushioned body that wraps you fully—it’s made for slow hours and deep comfort.

features.title: Soft support that stays with you
features.text: Genuine leather meets plush foam to create a cushion that holds you just right—at every pressure point.

features.title: Full-body comfort at your command
features.text: With a touch of a button, Volga shifts to your ideal angle—quiet, fluid, and entirely on your terms.

features.title: Recline, rock, and restore
features.text: Whether you’re leaning back or gently swaying, Volga helps your body decompress in motion.

features.title: We adapt to your body’s needs
features.text: With motorised adjustment for both headrest and lumbar support, Volga lets you fine-tune every angle—so your neck and lower back are always exactly where they need to be.

features.title: Connected even while unplugging
features.text: USB ports keep your devices charged, so you don’t have to get up to stay tuned in.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
